name: scoville network
description:
scoville network is a minecraft server running on version 1.12 that specializes in user-created parkour maps.
it started as a passion project and quickly grew in scope to allow for user profiles with saving and loading data,
leaderboards, custom music for every user course on the server, creative plots, and more.

the server is owned by zpicy, and the entire codebase is written by me, containing everything from the cosmetics
to the permissions to the menus to the course and player logic. a full modern rewrite is in progress.

name: vigenere cipher
description:
vigenere cipher is a custom module for keep talking and nobody explodes, made to dip my toes into learning unity.
it's solved by comparing the display characters on the module to information found elsewhere on the bomb.

the “expert” has a custom-made manual page that explains how the process of defusing the module works,
and the module itself has twitch integration for “twitch plays” live streams so the chat can input commands to solve the module.

name: gd heardle
description:
gd heardle is a heardle-based website where you have 5 guesses to figure out the song.
each guess gives you more and more time at the beginning of the song to help you figure it out.

the list of songs ranges from very common songs in the geometry dash community such as supernova by xtrullor,
to fairly unknown songs that still have a big presence in some way such as zombie attack by spline.
